verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official MCP server that connects external AI assistants to search errors, analyze performance, and triage issues, and it is included even on the free tier. It also has a documented web API for managing and exporting data. Together these let an external agent pull production telemetry, including trace and performance data, for debugging. missing for 10: explicit evidence that logs and metrics (not just errors and performance) can be queried through the API or MCP, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven querying.
